title: U.S. Gold Corp. Announces Participation in September 2026 Investor Conferences :: U.S. Gold Corp. (USAU)
body_markdown:
CHEYENNE, Wyo.


, Sept. 8, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- U.S. Gold Corp. ("U.S. Gold," the "Company," "we," "our" or "us") (Nasdaq: USAU), a U.S. focused gold and copper exploration and development company, today announces its participation in four key investor conferences during September 2026. Management will attend these events to engage with investors, analysts, and industry peers, highlighting the Company's advanced CK Gold Project in Wyoming and its broader portfolio of exploration assets.


**Conference Schedule:**


- Moody Capital Solutions - Disruptive Growth & Life Sciences Conference
September 9–10, 2026 The Westin New York Grand Central, New York, NY
[Click here to register](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4768680-1&h=3072344557&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.meetmax.com%2Fsched%2Fevent_139861%2Finvestor_reg_new.html%3Fattendee_role_id%3DMOODY_INVESTOR&a=Click+here+to+register)
- H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference September 14–16, 2026 Lotte New York Palace Hotel, New York, NY Investor Registration:[Click here to register](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4768680-1&h=1094093786&u=https%3A%2F%2Fct.to%2FOEwyvif&a=Click+here+to+register)
- 2026 Precious Metals Summit Beaver Creek September 22–25, 2026 Beaver Creek Resort, Beaver Creek, CO Investor Registration (qualification required):[Online Investor Qualification Request Form](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4768680-1&h=3484759965&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.meetmax.com%2Fsched%2Fevent_135899%2Finvestor_reg_new.html%3Fattendee_role_id%3DPMS2_ATTENDEE%26grp_name%3DPending%26approved%3DP&a=Online+Investor+Qualification+Request+Form)
- Mining Forum Americas 2026 September 27–30, 2026 The Broadmoor Hotel & Resort, Colorado Springs, CO Registration:[Register Here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4768680-1&h=3119094087&u=https%3A%2F%2Fattendee.miningforum.com%2Fregistration%2F%3Fid%3D73&a=Register+Here) (New attendees: Qualify first[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4768680-1&h=1012696230&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.denvergold.org%2Finvestor-qualification%2F&a=here) )


U.S. Gold Corp. looks forward to connecting with attendees and sharing updates on its fully permitted CK Gold Project, which features robust economics from the recent Feasibility Study, along with exploration potential at its Keystone project in Nevada and Challis Gold project in Idaho.


**About U.S. Gold Corp.** U.S. Gold Corp. is a publicly traded, U.S.-focused gold and copper exploration and development company. The Company has a portfolio of exploration properties. The flagship CK Gold Project is located in southeast Wyoming. The Keystone exploration property is on the Cortez Trend in Nevada. The Challis Gold Project is located in Idaho. For more information, visit[www.usgoldcorp.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4768680-1&h=3611113558&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.usgoldcorp.com%2F&a=www.usgoldcorp.com) .
